filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Currently supported filters are:

+ project: filters views by the project their associated query is assigned to. If the project filter is passed with the `!*` (not any) operator, global views are returned.

+ id: filters views based on their id

+ type: filters views based on their type (operations: list)

id.description: View id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: get, create)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
